title: Central Atlantic Magmatic Province (CAMP) eruptions
note: Child of the Pangaea breakup. Strong open-access dating (Oliveira et al. 2023, Sci. Rep.; Whiteside et al. 2010, PNAS). Centre the under-recorded South American and West African outcrops (Amazonas, Parnaíba and Solimões basins, Senador Pompeu dykes, Kakoulima in Guinea), not only Newark/Fundy. Area estimates range from c. 7 to 15 million km²; reconcile.

title: End-Triassic mass extinction
note: One of the big five. Continental 201.564 ± 0.015 Ma, marine 201.51 ± 0.15 Ma; causal link to CAMP debated. Marine sections in Peru (Pucará Basin) and the North American Cordillera.

title: Opening of the South Atlantic Ocean
note: Heine et al. 2013 (Solid Earth, open access): rifting from 140 Ma, Santos–Benguela break-up c. 113 Ma, equatorial break-up 103 Ma. Link the Paraná–Etendeka flood basalts (Brazil/Namibia) and the Angolan and Brazilian pre-salt basins.

title: Separation of India from Madagascar
note: Gibbons et al. 2013 (94–84 Ma, south to north) vs Gilbert et al. 2024 (c. 83 Ma); Madagascar volcanics 88 Ma (Storey et al. 1995). Sets up Madagascar's isolated biota. Indian Ocean and Africa are under-covered in deep time.

title: India–Asia collision and rise of the Himalaya
note: USGS This Dynamic Earth gives 50–40 Ma; the 'soft collision' near 50 Ma and later hard collision are debated. Ends the India drift thread of the Pangaea record.

title: Alfred Wegener
note: Life path Berlin – Marburg – Hamburg – Graz – Greenland (died Nov 1930 near Eismitte; companion Rasmus Villumsen, a Greenlandic Inuk, also died and deserves mention). NASA Earth Observatory biography opened. Child: 1912-01-06 Frankfurt lecture.
